name: Reiki and energy healer

pf.license.need: none checked by Rosie: reiki has no state license in most places; a certificate or training is the practitioner's own word, optional, and never checked (D96)
pf.license.who: the business, for any registration it chooses to show; each practitioner's certificate is their own word
pf.license.ask: optional: a registration number or a certificate the business wants shown; nothing is asked of each practitioner
pf.license.check: none: Rosie never checks a license, certificate or insurance for this work (not on any lookup, not by the team)
pf.license.certificates: a reiki level certificate is shown as the practitioner's own word, never as a license
pf.license.blocks: nothing: no license or certificate blocks a booking here
pf.license.renewals: none checked; a date on a certificate is only a reminder the business sets itself
pf.license.insurance: liability insurance is optional: the business's own word; shown only if the business chooses
pf.license.background: any background check is the business's own policy, not checked by Rosie
pf.license.claims: no medical claims: reiki is offered as a relaxing session, never as treatment, a cure or a diagnosis

pf.services.shape: one-to-one sessions of 60 minutes, with a practitioner the client picks or any free one; distance sessions by video or phone; packs of sessions; a home visit
pf.services.examples: the example businesses' own prices (Lee Reiki Studio and Lee Mobile Reiki), not a standard

list.name: 60-min reiki session
list.length: 60 min, plus 15 min to reset the room
list.before: a card saved for the $40 fee
list.note: clothes stay on; the client lies or sits, covered by a blanket

list.name: 5-session pack (60 min each)
list.before: paid in full when booked, on the secure page or at the desk

list.name: Distance reiki (45 min)
list.before: a card saved for the $35 fee
list.after: charged when the practitioner texts DONE, after the call

list.name: 60-min reiki at home
list.before: a card saved for the $70 fee

list.name: Crystal add-on
list.length: added to a session, same time
list.where: at the studio or at home
list.after: at the front desk, or on the bill

pf.services.travel: included in the price at home inside the 25-mile area (the example's setting); a travel fee for farther towns where Sam sets one
pf.services.capacity: one practitioner per session; a two-person session needs two practitioners free at once; a group is one booking with several people
pf.services.skills: reiki levels I and II, hands-on and distance sessions, crystal add-ons; only practitioners with the level a booking names are offered
pf.services.online: distance sessions by video or phone are a booking like any other; the video link is on the secure page
pf.services.nobodyHome: never: the client must be there for a home session

beforeTimes: the kind of session (at the studio, at home, or by video or phone)
a practitioner by name, or a woman or a man, only if the client asks
for a teen (16 or 17): the age; a parent or guardian books
at home: what kind of place (a home or an office) and the town, before any times
afterTime: what the client would like to focus on, in their own words (calm, sleep, pain, a change)
at home: parking, stairs, pets, and a quiet space with room for a chair or a table
securePage: 18 or older, or 16 or 17 with a parent or guardian's consent on the page
the wellness form: current health concerns, a heart condition, epilepsy, pregnancy, recent surgery, medicines, skin conditions, and any doctor's care
for a teen: the parent's consent, and that the parent stays on site
pf.questions.whoMayBook: an adult, for themselves or another adult; a parent or guardian for a 16 or 17 year old, who stays on site; no one under 16 (the example's setting)

stop.words: chest pain, trouble breathing, fainting, sudden weakness or numbness, or a seizure
stop.say: This could be an emergency. Call 911 now. A session can wait.

stop.words: a new lump, bleeding that won't stop, or a symptom a doctor hasn't checked
stop.say: Please see a doctor first. Reiki doesn't replace medical care.
stop.booking: no booking until a doctor says it's OK

refuse.words: a request for sexual services, or to skip the covering that keeps the client covered
refuse.say: This practice offers reiki sessions only. This request can't be booked.
refuse.what: the exact words go to the business's safety log; Sam picks: refuse and block that chat or number, or it was innocent and a session may be booked (every later message is checked again); no reply in 2 of Sam's text hours: nothing is booked

goOn.words: a sore muscle or a small bruise
goOn.what: the practitioner works around it; the session goes on
the visit moves with no fee

pf.safety.always: the generic screen: danger to life, fire, gas, a medical emergency → call 911, and no booking

steps.name: Wellness form
steps.when: on the secure page before the first session (due when booking, inside the saved 10 minutes); a returning client confirms or updates it by the day before (the studio: 6pm; the mobile business: 10am)
steps.goodFor: 12 months, or until the client's health changes
steps.result: most answers change nothing; a flag (a heart condition, epilepsy, a recent surgery) goes to the practitioner to read before it books

steps.name: Practitioner's read of a flag
steps.when: before the booking is written, in the practitioner's text hours; no answer in 1 hour: Sam reads it
steps.result: OK as booked; OK with a note (a lighter touch, an area skipped); a doctor's OK first; or no, with the reason kept private

steps.name: A teen's consent
steps.when: on the secure page, from the parent or guardian who books
steps.result: the parent shows an ID at check-in and stays on site

pf.first_steps.prep: come 5 minutes early; wear loose clothes; drink water; tell the studio on the secure page about any health change; at home: a quiet room with space for a chair or table, pets in another room

pf.visit.checkIn: at the studio: the check-in code at the front desk; at home: the code at the door, from the client who booked; by video or phone: the link on the secure page
pf.visit.beforeWork: the practitioner goes over the wellness form and what the client wants with the client before starting; the client keeps their clothes on and is covered by a blanket; the client can stop at any time
pf.visit.changes: a crystal add-on or extra time is priced and OK'd before it's done
pf.visit.stop: the practitioner may end a session that crosses a line and leave the room; Sam decides any charge (only what the client agreed to) and any block; it goes in the safety log
pf.visit.away: only practitioners Sam allows go to homes or offices; the practitioner's DONE is the check-out: no DONE 15 minutes after the booked end, Rosie texts, then calls the practitioner, then tells Sam with the address
pf.visit.done: the check-in code, or DONE from the practitioner; the practitioner's notes (what was focused on, what helped) go in the client's private record

pf.money.before: at the studio: a card saved for the $40 late-cancel and no-show fee; a 5-session pack paid in full when bought; by video or phone: a card saved for the $35 fee and charged at DONE; at home: a card saved for the $70 fee, or a 3-session pack paid in full
pf.money.caps: no deposits are taken for reiki; the business's own fee is never more than what was paid now or what the card covers
pf.money.cancel: free to cancel until 24 hours before at the studio or by video, and until 8pm the evening before for a visit at home (the owner's settings)
pf.money.fees: late cancel or no-show: $40 at the studio; $35 for a distance session; $70 at home; a pack session used up if Sam confirms; Sam confirms each fee, never more than what was agreed; a late arrival keeps the time booked at full price
pf.money.conduct: a session ended for the client's conduct: charged only what the booking page said, and only if Sam says so
pf.money.packs: packs of sessions and gift cards: sold at the studio, or on the secure page where Sam turns it on; a visit uses one session
pf.money.tips: on: at the front desk, or a tip line on the bill Rosie texts; tips go to the practitioner in full
pf.money.tax: a tax line where the state's rules tax the service
pf.money.insurance: none: the business bills no health plan or insurance; a practice that bills a plan would turn it on

pf.messages.never: health answers, pregnancy, medicines, a doctor's note and the practitioner's notes never go in a text or through the AI: only the secure page and the client's private record
pf.messages.tone: no words in any text that could read as medical care, a cure or a diagnosis; a reiki session is a relaxing session
pf.messages.minors: a teen's booking texts go only to the parent or guardian; Rosie never texts the teen

pf.staff.licenses: no state license for reiki in most places; a certificate or training is each practitioner's own word, shown only if they choose; never checked by Rosie (D96)
pf.staff.skills: reiki levels I and II, hands-on and distance sessions, crystal add-ons; only practitioners with the level a booking names are offered
pf.staff.gender: each practitioner's gender is set only so a client can ask for a woman or a man; a filter used only when the client asks
pf.staff.supervision: a student works only with a named practitioner in the room, where the business sets it (none in the example)
pf.staff.oks: Sam OKs same-day sessions and new clients at the studio; he can set every home visit to ask him first; a health flag goes to the booked practitioner, then to Sam after 1 hour
pf.staff.standIn: a stand-in must fit what the client asked (a woman, if asked) and the level booked, and gets the wellness form and notes
pf.staff.away: only practitioners Sam allows are offered for homes and offices

pf.rules.showLicense: no license claim on listings, times or confirmations; the business's own registration shows only if it has one
pf.rules.draping: the client stays covered as the practice does; a request to skip the covering is refused
pf.rules.hours: no sessions in hours the business has not set (the example's own hours)
pf.rules.away: home visits only inside the 25-mile area, and only where Sam allows the practitioner
pf.rules.minors: a parent or guardian's written consent on the secure page for a 16 or 17 year old, and a parent on site
pf.rules.reset: 15 minutes between clients to reset the room (the example studio's setting)
pf.rules.records: wellness forms and session notes kept 7 years

pf.edges.improper: a request for sexual services: refused, logged and sent to Sam (pf.safety)
pf.edges.lateArrival: the session ends on time at full price; at the studio, no word 15 minutes after the start is a no-show
pf.edges.runsLate: the practitioner runs late: the client keeps the full time if the next booking and the 15-minute reset still fit; if not, a new time with no fee
pf.edges.standIn: a stand-in who fits what the client asked and the level booked, with the form and notes; or new times with no fee
pf.edges.healthChange: a new health change before the session: the client updates the form; the practitioner decides; a move has no fee
pf.edges.conduct: a session ended for the client's conduct: Sam decides any charge (only what was agreed) and any block
pf.edges.awaySafety: the safety check-out after visits at a home or an office
pf.edges.other: all other edge cases the generic way

story.A: Sam Lee signs up two companies by text. Then Alex books a 60-min reiki session with Mira at Lee Reiki Studio, for Sat Oct 24 at 11:00am. Alex fills in the wellness form on the secure page, and a card is saved for the studio's $40 fee. Pick a money choice at the top to follow its path.
story.B: Sam Lee signs up two companies by text. Then Alex books a 60-min reiki session at home, 9 Birch Ct, with Owen from Lee Mobile Reiki, Thu Oct 22 at 8:00am.
